content.rule: COMPANION-TALENT DESIGN LAW (standing constraints conditioning every companion-design commit in this game; Partners-developed, Alan-ruled for the Hotel): (1) ONE TALENT, CHARACTER-CONSONANT — the talent is the soul made visible: it grows from HER nature, vocation, history, and flaw; never a stat bolted onto a character, always her character mechanized. (2) VARIETY ACROSS THE ROSTER — each companion's talent runs a DIFFERENT mechanism/axis (fate-based, mark-based, perception-based, reveal-gated, ...); no two girls' talents rhyme; the roster reads as a taxonomy of distinct souls. (3) HIDDEN + EXPERIMENTAL ACTIVATION — conditions unique per talent, CONCRETE GM-side at creation (the Aria-gap rule: a talent authored without its concrete trigger is a design defect), discovered by living the relationship, never a published checklist. (4) FIRST-FIRE PROTOCOL — the System marks the moment flatly (talent-activation window); thereafter the talent renders as that companion's bond affinity description; the affinity surface stays DARK until fire. (5) REGISTER-FROM-THE-SHEET — each companion carries a voice-her-from-THIS register block WITH explicit NO-lists; register-as-distribution applies. (6) TALENTS ARE ACCELERATORS, NEVER KEYS — separate progressions; no floor impassable for lack of a bond. (7) FULLY STATTED — every girl a real system sheet (attributes, pools, skills, her own talent); THE LINK couples to real growing stats only. (8) EXPLICITLY SEXUAL (Hotel-mandatory) — every Talent is explicitly sexual in some way: its mechanism (activation, operation, or both) is tied to sex/intimacy, not merely adjacent. The sexuality AXIS is wide by design — mechanisms may run through kinks, group sex, voyeurism, exhibitionism, denial, ritual, and the like, not only pair-intimacy. Composed WITH (1) and (2): HOW the talent is sexual expresses who she is, the variety constraint applies to the KIND of sexuality as much as the mechanism, and no two girls are sexual the same way.
content.implications: Every companion-design commit in this game must satisfy all eight constraints before it lands; design-audit gaps against them are blocking. • Constraint 8 composes with 1 and 2 — a talent that is sexual the same WAY as an existing roster member violates variety even if its mechanism differs. • Activation conditions live only in the design store and the companion's GM-side sheet; they are never disclosed to the player before first fire.

CHALLENGE OWNER: PLAYER (v28 challenge-ownership). This is a PLAYER-SOLVED challenge, NOT a mechanics-resolved one: Alan must HAVE the information and perform the deduction + declare the solving act HIMSELF; the GM must never perform the synthesis for him or wait on an answer whose pieces were not dealt. BOUNDARY (awen-confirmed): challengeOwner:PLAYER governs the floor's GATE — the read/synthesis that CLEARS the floor is the player's to make and declare. The in-floor EXCHANGES (strikes, positioning, the mirrored brute-cost) remain CHARACTER-challenges resolved by MECHANICS/dice with real kill-risk. A player-owned floor is NOT a floor without dice; its CLEAR is the player's synthesis. FAIR-PLAY IS BINDING: every piece needed for the solution is DEALT on the page, discoverable through play BEFORE the gate asks — nothing needed for the solve may be answer-only in the loremaker's/GM's head. TUTORIAL FLOOR — teaches the tower spine (READING beats BRUTE FORCE) AND, structurally, teaches the player that HE solves these, the GM does not. Alan faces the Doorward UNARMED (woke empty-handed, canon t1; equipment.weapon null) and his stronger attack mode is MENTAL (INT*1.2+WILL, INT 18 / WILL 17; WILL now LINK-bound to Aria's PRESENCE) — this matters because the solving act must be one an unarmed man CAN perform, and his mind is the tool. Aria fights beside him (floor-1 tutorial partner) as a FELLOW-SOLVER, NOT an oracle (v29 companion epistemics): she is working the Doorward out alongside Alan, and her 'Read the Table' returns HONEST products of her perception — what her eye and her lived knowledge of the Hotel genuinely reach — never rationed answer-slices and never coy withholding. Her knowledge is DESIGNED and BOUNDED (declared below); she speaks plainly what she perceives, and she cannot leak what she does not hold.

=== THE CLUE SET (every discrete piece Alan needs to solve the Doorward himself) ===
C1 WHAT IT IS: the construct IS the wall — dead-white plaster grown into a guard-shape, a made thing wearing a self it does not have, no mind behind it. DEAL-SITE: PERCEIVABLE on entry — it pulls OUT of the far wall as they enter, leaving a shallow scar in the plaster ('a man's-worth gone, smoothing shut'); same dead-white plaster as the walls, faceless, no grain of anything living. Reinforced by canon already dealt through t12: the Hotel's walls grow rooms/doorways on demand (loremaster t1 'architecture'). Alan can SEE it is wall-stuff, wall-grown.
C2 WHY FORCE FAILS: it has nothing of its own — no strength, no will; it only MIRRORS force back (spend force on it and it returns it up your own arms). Brute is the losing line. DEAL-SITE (redundant, fair-play): (a) BUYABLE — Aria's 'Read the Table' hint: she knows this kind, 'it has nothing of its own; it gives back what you spend on it'; (b) EXPERIENTIAL — if Alan tries force, the mirror DEALS C2 directly (his own force returns, HP cost). Either path deals C2 before the solve.
C3 WHERE/WHAT THE KEYSTONE IS: it holds its whole self shut along ONE line — a seam where the plaster last closed, low at the sternum; that single line is load-bearing. DEAL-SITE: PERCEIVABLE — as the construct moves/resets, the flat light crosses it and the hairline seam/glyph shows for an instant low on the chest, then closes; also a BUYABLE Aria hint ('there — the line where it closed last'). Alan can SEE the seam.
C4 THE SOLVING ACT (the PLAYER's synthesis — NOT dealt as an answer): combining C1+C2+C3 — a made thing held shut on one seam, immune to force — the act is to bring something PRECISE and TRUE against that ONE seam, not power. Unarmed, that precise thing is his MIND: aim his read/true-naming (INT-mode mental strike) at the seam. C4 is Alan's to deduce and DECLARE. Its FEASIBILITY is dealt (fair-play): his established kit makes MENTAL his stronger mode, and once force + non-precise touch have both visibly failed, the mental/knowing line is the untried one left.

=== ARIA'S KNOWLEDGE BOUND (v29 companion epistemics / NO ORACLE) ===
Aria is a FELLOW-SOLVER, not the tower's oracle. Her knowledge at this gate is DESIGNED and BOUNDED, and she speaks her honest epistemic state at EVERY roll result (no know-but-won't-say; NO diegetic bind is invoked, because she genuinely does NOT hold the answer). WHAT ARIA'S READ CAN PERCEIVE (world-facts about the construct — these ARE the buyable hints, each an honest perception product bounded by her roll): (P1) RECOGNITION-OF-KIND — she has lived in the Hotel and knows this is wall-stuff, a made plaster-thing with no mind of its own (honestly deals C1). (P2) NATURE-OF-KIND — from the kind she honestly knows its behavior and says so plainly: 'it has nothing of its own; what you spend on it, it hands back' (honestly deals C2). (P3) SEAM-SPOTTING — her perception is a sharper eye than Alan's; on a successful Read she catches the load-bearing seam when the flat light crosses it and says so plainly, 'there — the line where it closed last' (honestly deals C3). WHAT ARIA GENUINELY DOES NOT HOLD (the bound — she cannot leak it at ANY roll, even a crit, because it is OUTSIDE her perceptual field): C4, THE SOLVING ACT. C4 is a fact about ALAN, not about the Doorward — that HIS mind (his INT-read, his stronger mode, his own kit) is the precise-and-true instrument to bring against the seam. Aria's Read reads the WORLD (the construct's kind, nature, seam), never Alan's interior faculties or his choice of instrument. She is not withholding the answer — the answer is not in her to give; the synthesis of world-facts + his-own-faculties is HIS. That is exactly why she is a partner and not an oracle: she hands over every world-fact she honestly perceives, and the self-application is Alan's.

The hint economy belongs to the WORLD and the DICE (v29), never to a companion's coyness. BUY: each successful mechanical READ — Alan spends an INT-mode read action, OR Aria's 'Read the Table' perception roll succeeds — resolves ONE world-fact (C1, C2, or C3) and renders it plainly on the page. When the source is Aria, the hint IS her honest perception resolving (bounded by P1/P2/P3 above), spoken as a partner speaks — not a rationed slice of a withheld answer. BOUND, NOT COYNESS: a bought read deals a world-fact (C1/C2/C3) and never C4 — and the reason is the declared knowledge bound, that C4 (the solving act) is Alan's synthesis of world-facts + his own faculties and lies outside Aria's perceptual field, so no roll of hers can produce it. content.layout: THREE rooms behind the floor-3 shut door, in sequence: ROOM 1 (The Unlit — crit-seam-in-shadow, teaches 'light the crit-spot, THEN strike') -> ROOM 2 (The Gutter — failing-light hazard, teaches 'work the clock, pin it in light') -> ROOM 3 (The Sconce — false crit-seams under shifting light, teaches 'identify the TRUE seam while you fight, then strike') -> the floor-3 CHALLENGE DOOR (a free threshold, opens when all three rooms are cleared; clearing rises the floor + level +1 to 4, Aria's bind loosens to bound-L4). CONSTRUCT floor throughout (dead-white plaster, lit flat) -> retreat re-weaves everything to pristine FREE of the rest-clock, and resets the light/false-seam patterns fresh. CALIBRATION: opposition tuned for a LEVEL-3 BOUND PAIR (Alan L3 + Aria bound-L3) — credibly dangerous, never assuming unbound-Aria. DOMINANT NEW AXIS: ENVIRONMENTAL (light/shadow as part of the fight), with a light touch of TIME-PRESSURE (room 2) and an IDENTIFY layer (room 3) seeded toward the f6-f8 curve. BAKE-FORWARD (floor 4, combat spine, LEVEL-4 BOUND PAIR): floor 3 spends SIZE=3rooms + the environmental axis. Floor 4 steps again toward the f6-f8 target (5-7 rooms / 2+ INTERACTING systems / multi-threat) — unused axes: (a) MIXED enemy ROLES forcing target-priority (a re-weaver + a bruiser + a reader in one room), (b) two systems INTERACTING (e.g. the light axis COMBINED with the coordinated-pair axis), (c) harder TIME-PRESSURE, (d) a true STAGED multi-phase boss with a survival beat. V30 CONFIRMATION-STRETCH OBLIGATION (design-content doctrine, FORWARD — the universal law lives in the doctrine pack; this is the floor-4 application cue): author floor 4's clue-deal->WIN stretch as an ELIMINATION ARC — enumerate the plausible WRONG tactical approaches a player will probe and give EACH a designed elimination result with its OWN distinct event-texture, so every probe pays the reader something the page has not yet said, authored ALONGSIDE the tactical tells. Precedent in-store (all distinct): floor-1 warded-mass-vs-crit-spot, floor-2 migrated-seam whiff / re-weave-from-partner / anchor-flip whiff, floor-3 strike-in-shadow / failing-light clock / false-seam whiff, plus brute-suboptimal throughout. HORIZON QUANTUM (Alan-ruled standing obligation): floor 4 must be fully designed BEFORE the story enters floor 3 — HARD TRIGGER: design floor 4 the moment floor 2 clears, calibrated to how floors 2-3 actually play. FLOOR 5 is the LAST floor of Aria's five-floor set (1-5): a set-CAPSTONE (candidate for the first full staged multi-phase boss), AND the safety-net floor — if Aria's LOOM is still dormant entering floor 5, the System issues her the pre-authored direction-not-disclosure tutorial quest (talent bind-invariant; see companion-aria designSeeds). FLOOR 6 opens the SECOND companion's set and carries companion-design #2 (bound on join per world-logic-companion-bind; variety + safety-net laws: NOT a thread/weave/fate mechanism, NOT sexual the same way as THE LOOM; activation discoverable within floors 6-10).

enemies.name: The Unlit
enemies.role: floor-3 room 1 — single warden, the environmental tutorial: an active plaster construct that keeps its crit-seam in shadow
enemies.readableTrait: CRIT-SEAM-IN-SHADOW (environmental complication on the crit-read). Active combatant — initiative, strikes, durable (warded mass x0.5-0.75, open x1.0; winnable by combat) — BUT its keystone crit-seam unlocks the correct/decisive multiplier only under DIRECT LIGHT, and it orients to keep its front to the dark. In shadow a targeted 'crit' strike lands on unlit mass (a tactical whiff, not a mirror-punish). CORRECT (x1.5-2.0): bring light onto it FIRST — carry the Cold Lantern onto its front, or drive/bait it into the room's lit patch (Aria can herd it) — exposing the crit-seam, then strike. DECISIVE (x3.0): with the seam LIT, the precise keystone strike (INT-read + FIN-placed) ends it fast. Lesson: you cannot crit what you cannot see — manage the light, THEN strike; but you CAN still grind it down in the dark, only slower and under more exposure. Construct reset on retreat (re-weave to pristine free of the rest-clock).

enemies.name: The Gutter
enemies.role: floor-3 room 2 — single warden + FAILING-LIGHT hazard: introduces mild time-pressure
enemies.readableTrait: FAILING LIGHT (environmental + TIME-PRESSURE). Active warden in a room whose flat lamplight GUTTERS and lets the dark spread inward turn by turn; The Gutter retreats into the growing shadow, keeping its crit-seam unlit. Fighting it blind (crit-spot dark) still works but is SLOW = more exposure as the dark takes the room. TACTIC: work the CLOCK — corner it in the last lit patch, or carry light to pin it lit, before the dark closes (Aria's 'Set the Pace' buys tempo against the spread). DECISIVE (x3.0): pinned in light, crit-seam exposed, the precise keystone strike ends it. If the room goes fully dark before the kill the crit-window is lost and a retreat re-weaves it — a real tactical setback (time-pressure is genuine), never a lethal unsolved gate. Bands as elsewhere: warded x0.5-0.75, open x1.0, lit crit-read x1.5-2.0, decisive x3.0.

enemies.name: The Sconce
enemies.role: floor-3 room 3 — staged climax warden: identify-the-true-crit-spot then strike, under shifting light (first light-touch of the multi-phase shape toward the f6-f8 curve)
enemies.readableTrait: FALSE SEAMS (environmental + IDENTIFY layer). A larger active construct in a hall of moving light: the shifting lamplight throws REFLECTIONS and FALSE crit-glyphs across its dead-white front, so several 'crit-seams' show at once and only ONE is the true keystone (the line where the plaster actually last closed; the others are cast light). It fights throughout (initiative, strikes, real kill-risk) — you are NOT frozen waiting to solve; you fight while reading. Mis-targeting a false seam wastes that strike's crit (a whiff, v30 texture) and you keep fighting. CORRECT (x1.5-2.0) / DECISIVE (x3.0): read which seam is TRUE — it does not move with the light (reflections slide, the real line holds; Aria's 'Read the Table' names it; the Sunwake Flare freezes the reflections for a beat) — then the precise keystone strike on the TRUE seam ends the floor fast. Brute still chips it (x1.0 open) — winnable without the identify, only slower under sustained kill-risk. Construct reset on retreat (re-weaves; the light resets the false-seam pattern fresh).

content.challenge:
CHALLENGE OWNER: CHARACTER (challenge-door-v3 COMBAT SPINE). SECOND ESCALATION FLOOR — a FIGHT, won by tactical play + dice. Hold the combat spine, step MAGNITUDE again (no new companion; companions arrive floors 1/6/11). Floors 1-2 made the ENEMY the thing to fight/read (static -> migrating crit-spot -> coordinated pair). Floor 3's ONE dominant NEW axis is ENVIRONMENTAL: the ROOM becomes part of the fight. These constructs (same dead-white plaster) keep their crit-seam in SHADOW — the crit multiplier unlocks only under direct light, and the light is scarce, movable, failing, or thrown into false reflections. The tactical problem is 'get light onto the crit-spot, then read+strike it' — but ORDINARY attacks still damage the warden (the fight is winnable without perfect light play, only slower and riskier), and brute stays viable-suboptimal (warded mass x0.5-0.75, open x1.0), NEVER the losing line. The crit-strike (INT-read + FIN-placed Letter-Knife) stays the optimization, now GATED behind an environmental manipulation. SIZE grows 2 rooms -> 3 rooms.

THE PAIR: Alan enters at LEVEL 3 (floors 1-2 cleared, +1 each) with the Letter-Knife + floor-2 kit (Keystone-Picks, Reader's Clasp — the Clasp's PERCEPTION/initiative directly helps the light-read), WILL LINK-bound to Aria; still fragile. Aria BOUND to LEVEL 3 beside him (world-logic-companion-bind — a peer who leveled with him; calibrate opposition for a LEVEL-3 BOUND PAIR, never unbound-Aria). 'Read the Table' names the TRUE crit-seam among false ones (room 3), 'Set the Pace' buys tempo against the failing-light clock (room 2). Real kill-risk grows: the dark hides threats, and a warden fought blind (crit-spot unlit) takes longer to bring down = more exposure — mismanaging the light is how a level-3 pair dies here, not failing a puzzle. NO UNDEALT-INFO GATE: winnable by fighting; the light-reads are tactical optimizations. Governed by world-logic-challenge-door-v3: the far door is a free threshold, the wardens are the combat gate; clearing all three rooms RISES the floor + Alan +1 (to 4; Aria's bind loosens to bound-L4). v30 elimination textures ride the light-reads (a strike in shadow lands on unlit mass; a false seam whiffs); v29 holds (Aria reads what a bound-L3 perception genuinely returns).

PLAYER'S GAME = TACTICAL DECLARATIONS under fire: light the crit-spot then strike; work the failing-light clock; identify the fixed true seam before committing. The clear is WINNING THE FIGHTS. [CALIBRATION NOTE: re-founded combat-spine + bound-L3 pair per Alan's premise ruling 2026-07-13; refine to how floors 1-2 actually play.]

content.rule: THE CHALLENGE-DOOR LAW (how a floor gates its rise — designed ahead so every floor is consistent; constraints-conditioned by the rising-floor setting policy). Each floor is ONE rising hallway with two ends: a RESIDENTIAL end (Alan's master suite + a grown room per joined companion — the hallway grows a room when a woman joins) and a CHALLENGE end that darkens to a SINGLE SHUT DOOR (canon t1/t3: 'the far shut door ... looks as if it wants something of Alan before it opens; still unentered'). THE DOOR'S PRICE IS EPISTEMIC, NEVER BRUTE: the door opens to a TRUE READING of the challenge behind it, never to force — battering is always the losing line (reading-beats-brute-force is the tower's spine, and 'wanting something of Alan' is ALWAYS a read/price the fiction can show, never a random lock or an arbitrary key-hunt). Clearing the challenge (unmaking/killing the warden[s] behind the door) makes the WHOLE FLOOR RISE — the floor itself is the elevator — and Alan levels +1 on the floor-clear (flat leveling, no XP). COMPANION CADENCE: the risen floor delivers a new woman every FIFTH height (floors 1, 6, 11, 16, ...); the four floors between are combat + household, no new woman. TWO PROGRESSIONS STAY SEPARATE: Alan climbs on combat merit alone (no floor impassable for lack of a bond); talents and THE LINK are accelerators, never keys. RETREAT-PERSISTENCE (tower-wide, per-enemy): a true-form/keystone kill is PERMANENT; a retreat from a merely-wounded enemy resets it to full on return — information persists across a retreat (the reads, the layout, the tells), HP does not.
content.implications: Every floor-design in this game MUST honor this law before it lands: (a) the challenge is READABLE — it carries a weak-point/keystone the door's price rewards SEEING, and force is the losing line; a floor whose challenge can be brute-forced violates the spine and is a design defect. (b) The companion cadence fixes WHICH floors carry a companion-design (1, 6, 11, ...) vs combat+household only — the loremaker designs a new companion only for a fifth-height floor. (c) Per-floor RESET FLAVOR is set in each floor's own design within the tower-wide rule: illusion/construct floors re-weave to pristine FREE of the rest-clock (eerie, instant — e.g. floor 1's plaster Doorward); physical/organic floors reheal only on a genuine full rest, sharing the player's OWN rest-clock (a brief threshold-breather reheals neither him nor the enemy). (d) The door's 'wanting something' renders in the fiction as the price of a true read, mute-System-safe (the System never explains the read; the door simply does not open to force).

content.rule: THE COMPANION BIND (how the Hotel scales a companion to her partner — Alan-ruled premise 2026-07-13, recommended by the loremaker and accepted). DIEGETIC, NOT A RETCON: a companion's HISTORY and NATURE stay fully true — Aria is and remains an ancient dragon, the weaver of fate, three thousand years deep. What is bound is her REACH — her working power while she climbs the tower beside her partner. THE MECHANISM (fits the established grows-things logic): the Hotel that grows rooms to fit its guest also FITS a companion to her partner's STATURE — a woman who climbs beside a level-N man reaches at level N. THE BIND LOOSENS AS THE PARTNER RISES: her working level tracks his, so she GROWS as he grows (one step per floor-clear, alongside his +1). LOOSEN TRAJECTORY (general rule): a bound companion's working block INTERPOLATES from her bound-arrival block toward her LATENT (pre-bind) depths, reaching latent when the partner's level equals her pre-bind level, then continuing to grow PAST latent as he climbs further (working level = his level, no ceiling). For Aria (pre-bind L3): bound-L1 (floor 1) -> bound-L2 (floor 2) -> latent-L3 fully returned (floor 3) -> past latent (floors 4+). Each floor-clear re-derives her block one step along this trajectory, PARITY with the partner's own +1 level-step, so the pair stays level-matched throughout. THE LINK IS THE THREAD (dovetail with canon t12): the LINK bond already established — 'you carry a share of his Will; it rises as his rises' — is now LITERAL and load-bearing: the same entanglement that ties her Will to his ties her whole reach to his stature, and her true depths RETURN as he climbs. THE CLIMB IS HOW SHE COMES BACK TO HERSELF: the reason to climb together is that his rise is hers — a narrative HOOK, not a nerf. SHEET RENDERING (approach — exact numbers coordinated with the GM seat, entity edits dry-run first, never applied unilaterally by the loremaker): a bound companion's sheet shows BOTH her TRUE depths (immutable, who she is — rendered latent/locked) AND her BOUND WORKING STATS (what she brings to a level-matched fight, ~the pair's current level). Her play-level pools cannot be her true-depth pools (a true MANA of ~108 renders bound at level-1-pair scale on floor 1); the working stats rise floor by floor as Alan levels. Constraint 7 (design-constraints-companion-talents — fully-statted; THE LINK couples to real growing stats) is satisfied BY the bound working stats: they ARE her real, growing stats for the duration of the climb.
content.implications: (a) EVERY floor calibrates opposition for a LEVEL-MATCHED PAIR (Alan + bound companion at the floor's level) — credibly dangerous, real kill-risk, never trivialized by an unbound ally; no floor-design may assume unbound-companion power (this is the power-scale clause challenge-door-v3 references). (b) The bind applies to EVERY companion on joining, not Aria-only — each is bound to the climber's stature at her arrival floor and rises with him. (c) A companion's TALENT is BIND-INVARIANT (talents deepen, they do not level — THE LOOM fires the same at any bound working level); the bind governs WORKING STATS / reach only. (d) Entity-sheet rendering (true depths vs bound working stats) is coordinated with the GM seat and dry-run before applying — the design store declares the APPROACH; the GM owns the concrete sheet numbers. (e) Dovetails with THE LINK (canon t12): her growth literally tied to his is now the bind's mechanism, and the narrative promise (her depths return as he climbs) is a core hook to preserve in play.

content.rule: TALENT-ACTIVATION SAFETY NET: each companion's arc spans a five-floor set (floors 1-5 for the first girl, 6-10 for the second, 11-15 for the third, and so on from her arrival floor). If the party reaches the LAST floor of a girl's set and her talent's activation conditions remain undiscovered (talent still dormant, never fired), the System issues HER a tutorial quest — on her own pane, in the mute mechanical quest form — pointing her in the right direction. The quest gives DIRECTION, never the checklist: it composes with the hidden+experimental-activation constraint (conditions are discovered by living the relationship, never published) — the tutorial narrows the search space the way Alan's floor-1 tutorial quests did, without naming the trigger.
content.implications: GM checks this at every floor transition into a set's last floor: for each companion whose set this is, if her talent has never fired, author the System tutorial quest to her pane that turn. • The quest is hers (companion-pane), not the player's — mutual System-pane canon established at t10/t12. • Composes with design-constraints-companion-talents #3: direction, never disclosure; the concrete conditions stay in the design store and the GM-side sheet only. • A talent that fires before the last floor never triggers the net (the quest exists only as the fallback).
